x-ectwin.runs_in: Step 5 of the gazetteer matcher (libs/ectwin_core/gazetteer.py, docs/05-data-catalog.md section 3.2) when exact, alias and fuzzy matching are ambiguous; batch over distinct unresolved strings
x-ectwin.data_class_rule: Only the place mention and at most 300 characters of pseudonymised context are sent.

placeholders.raw_place_text: Place text exactly as in the source (e.g. 'Rosa Zarate', 'Qninde', 'Parroquia 5 de Agosto')
placeholders.context_text: Up to 300 characters of surrounding pseudonymised text, or empty string
placeholders.province_hint: Province name if the source record has one, else empty string
placeholders.canton_hint: Canton name if the source record has one, else empty string
placeholders.candidates: Object c1..c5 (the matcher's top 5 candidates within the parent unit); values 'Parroquia X (rural|urbana), Canton Y, Provincia Z'; code keeps the cN -> DPA mapping
placeholders.candidate_criteria: Object with the same keys as candidates mapped to null, plus "none": "None of these candidates"

code_decides_without_jev: Steps 1-4 of the matcher in docs/05 section 3.2 (normalise, exact, alias via commons_internal.dim_dpa_alias, fuzzy Jaro-Winkler >= 0.92 with margin >= 0.03) resolve names without any Jev call.
Strings already in dim_dpa_alias are never re-sent; confirmed answers are written back to dim_dpa_alias.
notes: INEC DPA reference files list 24 provinces, 226 canton codes and 1,041 parishes (CLASIFICADOR_GEOGRAFICO_2024); use the official list loaded in dim_dpa.
Recintos and sitios below parish level map to their parish when the candidate text says so; otherwise the analyst decides.

match.instructions: Which entry in `candidates` is the place that `mention.text` refers to, taking `mention.context`, `mention.province_hint` and `mention.canton_hint` into account?

criteria.canton: A canton or its main town
criteria.localidad: A smaller locality: recinto, sitio, comuna, barrio or neighbourhood
criteria.rio_o_accidente: A river, estuary, road or natural feature
